explanation: The application scored 0.82, above the 0.50 review threshold, mainly because the email address is only 7 days old and the address has 5 applications in the last 30 days. The device was used for 3 other applications in the same window, and the SSN prefix reuse rate (0.63 vs. baseline) and name-email mismatch add further risk, along with a thin credit file. Mitigating signals are a non-VoIP phone with about 3.3 years of tenure and an IP location only 16 km from the stated address, which may support approval after the address and device activity are verified.
